page_title: VER 0-3 JUV | Verona v Juventus 26/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Abdou Harroui (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' A spell of possession for Verona in an attempt to control the game.
85' Substitution. Ondrej Duda leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dani Silva (Verona).
85' Substitution. Lorenzo Anghele (Juventus) replaces Andrea Cambiaso.
85' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danilo (Juventus) replacing Federico Gatti.
84' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus).
83' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
82' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Antonio Giua who sees an offensive foul.
81' Abdou Harroui (Verona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
80' Michele Di Gregorio leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
80' A cross into the box from Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is cleared.
77' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Juan Cabal is replaced by Jonas Rouhi (Juventus).
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) is replacing Nicolo Savona.
74' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
72' The current number of shots on goal is 0:5.
70' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' The substitution is prepared. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuel Mbangula.
67' The resulting corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) comes to nothing.
67' Tomas Suslov (Verona) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Antonio Giua signals. Verona will take a free kick near the side line.
64' Substitution. Darko Lazovic makes his way off the pitch and Abdou Harroui (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
64' Antonio Giua has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tomas Suslov (Verona).
62' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
61' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
60' Juventus are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Faride Alidou (Verona) comes onto the pitch for Dailon Rocha Livramento.
56' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Casper Tengstedt (Verona) replaces Daniel Mosquera.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martin Frese (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Giangiacomo Magnani can be given a rest.
53' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Lorenzo Montipo no chance!
53' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
52' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
52' Referee Antonio Giua sees the trip by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Juventus are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
48' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

39' 0 - 2 Samuel Mbangula showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Nicolo Savona (Juventus) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:2.
36' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.

35' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Verona have a free kick from a promising distance.
34' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
33' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Giua blows his whistle for an infringement.

28' 0 - 1 Kenan Yildiz produces a sweet pass and picks out Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:1!
27' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' A cooling break is underway.
23' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
22' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
19' Antonio Giua blows his whistle and it's Juan Cabal (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

18' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo!
15' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is hurriedly cleared.
14' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
14' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
13' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) plays a through ball but overhits it.
7' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
5' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The linesman signals that Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Antonio Giua will officiate today.
